description_en: Queries the encryption key of a MongoDB instance
description_zh: 查询MongoDB实例的某个密钥的详情
name: DescribeDBInstanceEncryptionKey

parameters.description_en: The custom key for the instance. You can call the [DescribeUserEncryptionKeyList](~~151729~~) operation to query the list of custom keys for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance.
parameters.description_zh: 可以输入一个实例自定义密钥。您可以调用[DescribeUserEncryptionKeyList](~~151729~~)查询实例的自定义密钥列表。
parameters.help_en: The custom key for the instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151729.html operation to query the list of custom keys for an ApsaraDB for MongoDB instance
parameters.help_zh: 可以输入一个实例自定义密钥。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/151729.html查询实例的自定义密钥列表
parameters.name: encryption_key
